meta.scope: Adventure cycling, bikepacking, ultra-cycling, touring, gravel, MTB expedition planning and risk assessment for RideMore.bike planner integration

change_history.description: Initial research-backed foundation: sources registry (ACSM/ISSN/Jeukendrup/sleep ultra), core definitions, user_profile_schema skeleton, experts skeleton, sample declarative rules and calculations for nutrition/hydration/sleep based on verified sources. Full expert rule catalogs, dependency graph, conflict model, emergency scenarios and validation suite marked for iterative completion.

Expanded equipment (tire pressure individualization, repair kit, lights, luggage mass), adventure (first multi-day, supply contingency, bailouts), race_strategy (time margin, safety over finish). Added emergency scenarios and luggage time proxy calculation. New practical sources for pressure and weight.

Expanded logistics (stage vs experience, elevation flag, unpaved surface, POI hours) and ultra (central fatigue, positive pacing, sleep debt RPE). Added fatigue sources (Thomas 2015, Millet 2018). More emergency scenarios and elevation time proxy calculation.

Major expansion of Race Strategy: brevet time limits (ACP/RUSA), intermediate controls advisory, circadian sleep placement, chunking, early pacing risk, abandon criteria, sleep as strategy, missing data handling. Added time_margin calculation and approaching_time_cut emergency. New operational and practical sources.

Formal conflict_model with hierarchy, conflict types, resolution rules and blocking cases. Expanded validation with static checks, 8 logical test cases, and parameter_verification against collected sources. All key numeric bands re-checked vs ACSM, Jeukendrup, Thomas, Millet, Race Across France, ACP.

Structural response to review: data_dictionary + missing profile fields (body_mass_kg, planned_sleep_h_per_24, gi_tolerance); threshold_taxonomy and annotations on key rules; multi-dimensional confidence_model; condition_format unification notes; calculation non-overlap statements; two nutrition rules (GI gate, during vs total energy); path consistency fix for stage.planned_distance_km.

Nutrition GI handling made probabilistic: hard gate replaced by relative risk model gi_risk_vs_cho_rate with tunable parameters. High CHO rates surface soft risk bands; parameterization hidden under model; rider sensation remains primary. Aligns with practical reality that fueling is feel-based.
Fix log_elevation_heavy_stage to use stage.planned_distance_km; tighten log_poi_opening_hours_unknown to require poi context. Test harness added.

Operational hydration_carry_plan and nutrition_pack_plan models + calculations; rules that fire with quantitative params and clear when plan.satisfied; user_facing templates with placeholders; ACSM-aligned default 0.4-0.8 L/h operational start, CHO mid-bands.
nutrition_pack_plan: user.gel_cho_g (and bar/banana CHO) as first-class inputs; defaults only fallback; pack_cho uses actual gel grams; templates include gel_cho_g.

Architecture: shared stage_demand foundation; all models under models{}; gi_risk as probabilistic; nutrition unknown-pack buffer mode (~4h start CHO); experts remain rule namespaces not replaced by models; climb_segments contract.
Progressive decision tree spine (decision_tree.json); early POI suppression by start-stock coverage; trip.horizon and lodging paths in data_dictionary.

Unified layout: decision_tree + parameter_catalog embedded; phase→model→expert binding; stage_demand primary; old time/CHO calcs deprecated; engine_contract walk defined; single source of truth adventure_knowledge.json
Bilingual pl/en labels: decision_tree phases, models, rules name/explanation, recommendation templates, parameter groups, severity; i18n contract for PHP locale resolution.
Cleanup: models sole numeric layer; thin plan-trigger rules only; remove duplicate CHO/hydration essay rules and alias model namespaces; clear architecture separation.
Explicit formulas in models; effort_decay (power/CHO/fluid over time); time_margin model; thin ultra/race_strategy triggers; PHP formula_dsl; logistics elevation uses effort_factor.
Align wizard input paths with data_dictionary; add explicit planned-pack declaration semantics and input provenance; no numeric model changes.

changes: Removed effort-decay reductions from CHO and fluid targets.
Clarified event-specific sleep heuristic; threshold does not certify safety.
Added critical rule for very long no-sleep single-stage attempt by a beginner and actionable stop criteria.

change_history.description: Added deterministic recommendation composition contract: safety, nutrition and hydration cards combine source rules without inventing route stages, declared stock or verified POI availability.

Simplified progressive wizard contract: short mode defaults, prefill from rider profile/history/route/POIs, removed specialist physiology and manual POI-list questions, classified profile field origins and avoided assumed 10 kg luggage.

Stage 5 contract pass: define canonical multi-stage accounting, separate moving/stops/sleep time, formalize POI arrival/quantity/capacity/freshness eligibility, and require transparent per-stage load ledger instead of unvalidated cumulative fatigue score. Execution and PHP integration remain pending.
Add multi-stage water and CHO inventory event schema and executable reference ledger with confirmation, route ordering, carry-forward, shortage and unknown propagation.

meta.notes: Quality and source traceability prioritized over volume. Arbitrary thresholds avoided. Missing data handled via insufficient_data / user_input_required. Safety hierarchy enforced in conflict model (to be expanded).

definitions.distance: Total route length in km derived from GPX or planner.
definitions.elevation_gain: Cumulative positive elevation change in m.
definitions.surface_profile: Proportion or sequence of surface types (paved, gravel, singletrack, etc.).
definitions.intensity: Relative effort (easy / moderate / hard / threshold) or power/HR zones when available; otherwise proxy from speed vs typical user speed and elevation.
definitions.fatigue: Accumulated load and recovery debt; not a single number without sufficient inputs.
definitions.self_sufficiency: Degree to which rider can operate without external support (food, water, repair, lodging).
definitions.risk: Composite of probability and severity of adverse events (mechanical, physiological, environmental, logistical).
definitions.feasibility: Whether plan is achievable given user constraints, logistics and safety margins.
definitions.safety_margin: Buffer in time, energy, fluid, equipment or route alternatives.

core.unknown_handling: Never invent numeric values. Return insufficient_data or user_input_required with list of missing fields and which calculations/rules are blocked.

user_profile_schema.description: Shared schema used by all experts. Fields may be unknown; absence is not zero.

body_mass_kg.description: Body mass; required for some relative nutrition/rehydration calculations

planned_sleep_h_per_24.description: Planned or expected average sleep hours per 24 h during multi-day/ultra event

gi_tolerance_high_cho.description: Optional self-assessment of prior tolerance to high CHO rates during long efforts. Used only to shift relative risk bands; never as a hard eligibility gate. Unknown is a valid and common state.

gel_cho_g.description: g CHO in one gel the rider uses

ultra.name: Ultra Physiology & Pacing
ultra.description: Long-duration effort physiology, fatigue, pacing, multi-hour/day management. Practical insights separated from evidence.

adventure.name: Adventure & Self-Sufficiency
adventure.description: Self-sufficiency, contingency, resilience to change, emergency planning.

equipment.name: Equipment & Bike Fit to Route
equipment.description: Bike type, tires, gearing, repair kit, lighting, luggage suitability.

nutrition.name: Sports Nutrition
nutrition.description: Energy, CHO, hydration, electrolytes, multi-day feeding. Individualization required. No medical diagnosis.

logistics.name: Route Logistics & Infrastructure
logistics.description: GPX analysis support, stage division, POI quality, supply gaps, opening hours awareness.

race_strategy.name: Race / Event Strategy
race_strategy.description: Time limits, schedule, sleep/rest allocation, finish strategy, alternatives. Never recommend finishing at any cost.

name.pl: Brak masy ciała — część wyliczeń niedostępna
name.en: Cannot compute precise energy or fluid targets without body mass

description.pl: Brak user.body_mass_kg — część ścieżek względnych niedostępna.
description.en: Missing user.body_mass_kg — some relative paths unavailable.

explanation.en: Many guidelines express some targets relative to body mass; absolute CHO rates during exercise are often absolute but energy balance and rehydration volumes benefit from mass.
explanation.pl: Many guidelines express some targets relative to body mass; absolute CHO rates during exercise are often absolute but energy balance and rehydration volumes benefit from mass.

name.pl: Plan wody nie pokrywa etapu bez uzupełnienia
name.en: Planned water start does not cover stage need without timely resupply

description.pl: Wyzwalacz: plan.hydration.satisfied == false. Liczby z modelu hydration_carry_plan.
description.en: Trigger: plan.hydration.satisfied == false. Numbers from hydration_carry_plan model.

nutrition.limitations: Uses operational default rate unless user.sweat_rate_l_per_h provided.

explanation.pl: Reguła nie liczy litrów — tylko publikuje wynik modelu.
explanation.en: Rule does not compute litres — only publishes model result.

name.pl: Zapas jedzenia nie pokrywa zapotrzebowania CHO etapu
name.en: On-bike nutrition pack does not cover stage CHO need

description.pl: Wyzwalacz: plan.nutrition.satisfied == false i mode=pack.
description.en: Trigger: plan.nutrition.satisfied == false and mode=pack.

nutrition.limitations: Operational CHO mid-band; item sizes are defaults.

explanation.pl: Reguła nie liczy gramów CHO — wynik nutrition_pack_plan.
explanation.en: Rule does not compute CHO grams — nutrition_pack_plan result.

name.pl: Brak menu — bufor CHO na start i km uzupełnienia
name.en: Unknown pack — operational CHO start buffer and resupply km

description.pl: Wyzwalacz: plan.nutrition.mode == buffer i nie satisfied.
description.en: Trigger: plan.nutrition.mode == buffer and not satisfied.

nutrition.limitations: Assumes normal fueling rate; not a menu. Refine when user sets planned_pack.

explanation.pl: Reguła publikuje bufor/resupply z modelu; nie zakłada menu produktów.
explanation.en: Publishes buffer/resupply from model; does not assume product menu.

name.pl: Dostępne pasmo ryzyka GI z modelu
name.en: GI risk band available from model

description.pl: Wyzwalacz: istnieje plan.gi.risk_band. Bez ponownego liczenia.
description.en: Trigger: plan.gi.risk_band exists. No recalculation.

explanation.pl: Tylko prezentacja wyniku gi_risk_vs_cho_rate.
explanation.en: Presentation only of gi_risk_vs_cho_rate output.

name.pl: Niski planowany sen
name.en: Low planned sleep

description.pl: Wyzwalacz ostrzegawczy < 5.3 h/24. To heurystyka oparta na danych z określonego wydarzenia, nie uniwersalny próg bezpiecznego snu.
description.en: Warning trigger < 5.3 h/24. This is an event-specific heuristic, not a universal safe-sleep threshold.

explanation.pl: Nie traktuj wartości >=5.3 h jako potwierdzenia bezpieczeństwa. Oceniaj cały plan, wcześniejszy sen, długość wysiłku, zmęczenie i objawy senności.
explanation.en: Do not treat >=5.3 h as proof of safety. Consider the full schedule, prior sleep, effort duration, fatigue and sleepiness symptoms.

name.pl: Długi wysiłek ciągły
name.en: Long continuous effort

description.pl: Wyzwalacz: stage.estimated_time_hours >= 3 (po stage_demand).
description.en: Trigger: time >= 3 h from stage_demand.

explanation.pl: Informacja o zmęczeniu centralnym; liczby power_factor w effort_decay.
explanation.en: Central fatigue info; power_factor numbers in effort_decay.

name.pl: Bardzo długi przejazd bez snu przy braku doświadczenia
name.en: Very long no-sleep ride with limited experience

description.pl: Blokujący sygnał bezpieczeństwa dla bardzo długiego pojedynczego etapu bez planowanego snu u początkującego.
description.en: Safety-blocking flag for a very long single stage without planned sleep for a beginner.

ultra.limitations: 250 km is an operational trigger for review, not a universal physiological boundary. The rule flags this combination; it does not calculate individual crash probability.

explanation.pl: Nie przedstawiaj jazdy bez snu jako sukcesu. Wymagaj przeplanowania z odpoczynkiem/snem albo rezygnacji z próby. Nie pozwól, aby inne rekomendacje obniżyły ten poziom ryzyka.
explanation.en: Do not frame riding without sleep as success. Require a revised plan with sleep/rest or abandoning the attempt. Other recommendations must not downgrade this risk.

name.pl: Nie zakładaj dostępności niezweryfikowanego POI
name.en: Do not assume unverified POI is available

description.en: Existence of a POI on a map does not confirm current availability or opening hours.
description.pl: Existence of a POI on a map does not confirm current availability or opening hours.

explanation.en: Operational principle of the system: map presence ≠ confirmed availability. Critical for water and food on remote sections.
explanation.pl: Punkt na mapie bez weryfikacji nie jest pewnym zaopatrzeniem.

name.pl: Długość etapu względem typowego dystansu użytkownika
name.en: Stage length should respect user experience and multi-day status

description.en: For users without multi-day experience or with low typical distance, long stages increase risk of cascade fatigue and logistics failure.
description.pl: For users without multi-day experience or with low typical distance, long stages increase risk of cascade fatigue and logistics failure.

logistics.limitations: Typical distance is only a proxy; fitness, surface and elevation matter more. Not a hard block.

explanation.en: Practical risk management: stages substantially longer than recent typical rides raise uncertainty, especially on first multi-day trips.
explanation.pl: Practical risk management: stages substantially longer than recent typical rides raise uncertainty, especially on first multi-day trips.

name.pl: Wysokie przewyższenie — uwzględnij regenerację i tempo
name.en: High elevation gain stages require explicit recovery and pacing consideration

description.pl: Wyzwalacz: relative_effort_factor z stage_demand > 1.15 (zamiast gołego progu metrów).
description.en: Trigger: stage_demand relative_effort_factor > 1.15 (not raw metres alone).

logistics.limitations: 1500 m is an illustrative operational flag, not a physiological threshold. Intensity and rider strength matter more than absolute metres.

explanation.en: High elevation days accumulate peripheral load; subsequent recovery or reduced volume is commonly required in multi-day planning.
explanation.pl: High elevation days accumulate peripheral load; subsequent recovery or reduced volume is commonly required in multi-day planning.

logistics.threshold_notes: 1500 m is an illustrative operational flag only; must be interpreted with experience, bike, luggage and intensity

name.pl: Dużo nieasfaltu — korekta tempa i ryzyka mechanicznego
name.en: Significant unpaved surface slows expected speed and increases mechanical risk

description.en: When surface profile includes substantial gravel/singletrack, ride time estimates and equipment demands change; do not use pure paved typical speed.
description.pl: When surface profile includes substantial gravel/singletrack, ride time estimates and equipment demands change; do not use pure paved typical speed.

logistics.limitations: Exact slowdown factor is highly surface- and tire-dependent; system should prefer user typical off-road speed when available.

explanation.en: Unpaved surfaces increase rolling resistance, technical demand and puncture risk; pure road speed assumptions are invalid.
explanation.pl: Unpaved surfaces increase rolling resistance, technical demand and puncture risk; pure road speed assumptions are invalid.

name.pl: Nieznane godziny otwarcia obniżają wiarygodność POI
name.en: Unknown opening hours reduce POI reliability

description.en: If opening hours are unknown or outdated, treat the POI as lower confidence for critical resupply.
description.pl: If opening hours are unknown or outdated, treat the POI as lower confidence for critical resupply.

logistics.limitations: Fires only when a POI is in context, not on empty scenario.

explanation.en: Critical for water/food planning: map presence + unknown hours ≠ reliable access.
explanation.pl: Critical for water/food planning: map presence + unknown hours ≠ reliable access.

name.pl: Priorytet bezpieczeństwa globalnego
name.en: Safety hierarchy overrides other objectives

description.en: Any recommendation that increases serious risk to the rider is blocked or escalated regardless of time or finish goals.
description.pl: Any recommendation that increases serious risk to the rider is blocked or escalated regardless of time or finish goals.

explanation.en: Core hierarchy: human safety is the highest priority.
explanation.pl: Core hierarchy: human safety is the highest priority.

name.pl: Pierwszy multi-day / bikepacking — wyższa niepewność
name.en: First multi-day / first bikepacking elevates uncertainty

description.en: Lack of multi-day or bikepacking experience increases uncertainty around load, sleep, logistics and self-sufficiency; stages should be conservative.
description.pl: Lack of multi-day or bikepacking experience increases uncertainty around load, sleep, logistics and self-sufficiency; stages should be conservative.

adventure.limitations: Experience is multi-dimensional; some riders adapt quickly.

explanation.en: Practical principle: first loaded multi-day trips commonly reveal unexpected fatigue, packing issues and logistics friction. Conservative daily distances and early stops reduce risk of cascade failure.
explanation.pl: Practical principle: first loaded multi-day trips commonly reveal unexpected fatigue, packing issues and logistics friction. Conservative daily distances and early stops reduce risk of cascade failure.

name.pl: Duża luka zaopatrzenia wymaga planu awaryjnego
name.en: Long verified supply gaps require contingency

description.en: When logistics identifies a long gap without confirmed water or food, adventure module requires explicit contingency (extra carry, alternative route, or stage shorten).
description.pl: When logistics identifies a long gap without confirmed water or food, adventure module requires explicit contingency (extra carry, alternative route, or stage shorten).

adventure.limitations: Threshold of 40 km is illustrative; actual risk depends on temperature, carry capacity and individual needs. Exact numeric threshold left for engine configuration.

explanation.en: Self-sufficiency principle: large gaps without verified resupply are a primary risk vector in adventure and exploratory profiles.
explanation.pl: Długa luka bez pewnego zaopatrzenia wymaga planu awaryjnego (woda/jedzenie/ewakuacja).

adventure.threshold_notes: 40 km example is illustrative; real risk = f(carry capacity, temperature, individual needs, surface)

name.pl: Remote sections should have identified exit or bailout options
name.en: Remote sections should have identified exit or bailout options

description.en: For high self-sufficiency or exploratory profiles, plan should note realistic exit points (transport, accommodation, road access).
description.pl: For high self-sufficiency or exploratory profiles, plan should note realistic exit points (transport, accommodation, road access).

explanation.en: Risk management: ability to abandon or shorten without catastrophic consequence is core to safe adventure travel.
explanation.pl: Risk management: ability to abandon or shorten without catastrophic consequence is core to safe adventure travel.

name.pl: Tire pressure must be individualized to rider+bike mass, tire width and surface
name.en: Tire pressure must be individualized to rider+bike mass, tire width and surface

description.en: No universal tire pressure. On rough surfaces lower pressures often reduce impedance losses and improve comfort until the tire becomes too soft.
description.pl: No universal tire pressure. On rough surfaces lower pressures often reduce impedance losses and improve comfort until the tire becomes too soft.

equipment.limitations: Field tests show surface-dependent optima; manufacturer max pressure must never be exceeded. System weight (rider+bike+luggage) is a primary input.

explanation.en: Field roll-down and vibration tests indicate that on gravel/rough surfaces lower pressures can reduce rolling resistance and vibration compared with high road pressures, but the optimum is highly individual.
explanation.pl: Field roll-down and vibration tests indicate that on gravel/rough surfaces lower pressures can reduce rolling resistance and vibration compared with high road pressures, but the optimum is highly individual.

name.pl: Minimalny zestaw naprawczy na odcinki remote
name.en: Minimum repair kit for remote / self-supported sections

description.en: For sections with limited external support require basic puncture and mechanical self-repair capability.
description.pl: For sections with limited external support require basic puncture and mechanical self-repair capability.

equipment.limitations: Exact contents depend on tubeless vs tube, drivetrain type and remoteness. Knowledge of how to use the tools is required.

explanation.en: Practical consensus from established bikepacking resources: ability to fix common punctures and simple drivetrain issues is baseline for self-supported travel.
explanation.pl: Practical consensus from established bikepacking resources: ability to fix common punctures and simple drivetrain issues is baseline for self-supported travel.

name.pl: Adequate lighting required for planned night riding
name.en: Adequate lighting required for planned night riding

description.en: If night riding is planned or likely, front and rear lights meeting visibility and illumination needs must be present and charged.
description.pl: If night riding is planned or likely, front and rear lights meeting visibility and illumination needs must be present and charged.

equipment.limitations: Legal requirements vary by jurisdiction. Battery runtime must cover planned night duration plus margin.

explanation.en: Safety and legal baseline for night riding; insufficient lighting elevates crash and visibility risk.
explanation.pl: Safety and legal baseline for night riding; insufficient lighting elevates crash and visibility risk.

name.pl: Nieznana masa bagażu
name.en: Unknown luggage mass limits load-related calculations

description.en: When luggage mass is unknown, impact on climb performance and energy cannot be quantified.
description.pl: When luggage mass is unknown, impact on climb performance and energy cannot be quantified.

explanation.en: Practical tests show measurable but moderate time cost per extra kg on hilly routes; without the value the system cannot adjust estimates.
explanation.pl: Practical tests show measurable but moderate time cost per extra kg on hilly routes; without the value the system cannot adjust estimates.

name.pl: Ciasny lub ujemny margines czasu
name.en: Tight or negative time margin

description.pl: Wyzwalacz na race.margin_status z modelu time_margin.
description.en: Trigger on time_margin model output.

name.pl: Bezpieczeństwo nad finiszem
name.en: Safety over finish

description.pl: Hierarchia conflict_model — nie liczy tempa.
description.en: conflict_model hierarchy — no pacing math.

name.pl: Brak danych do marginesu czasu
name.en: Missing data for time margin

name.pl: Spadek względnej intensywności w długim etapie
name.en: Relative intensity decay on long stage

description.pl: Wyzwalacz na wynik effort_decay — bez własnego wzoru.
description.en: Trigger on effort_decay output only.

dependency_graph.notes: Rules run after models for the current decision_tree phase. No cycles.

confidence_model.description: Multi-dimensional confidence. Single scalar is derived, never the only stored value.

source_reliability.description: Credibility of the underlying source type and authors

completeness.description: How complete the input data for this case are

case_applicability.description: How well the evidence matches this user/route/conditions

confidence_model.derivation_policy: Engine SHOULD compute an aggregate only after storing dimension scores. Do not treat a hard-coded 0.8 in a rule as final case confidence.

separation.information_truth: Confidence that a fact (e.g. shop exists) is true
separation.recommendation_appropriateness: Confidence that the recommended action is appropriate for this specific user and context

confidence_model.missing_data_policy: Missing critical inputs lower completeness and case_applicability; quantitative recommendations that depend on them must return insufficient_data or user_input_required rather than a high-confidence number.

conflict_model.description: Formal conflict resolution between experts. Never simple majority vote. Hierarchy is absolute for safety.

hierarchy.label: Ograniczenia użytkownika i organizatora / limity czasowe wydarzenia

conflict_types.description: Ultra or Race Strategy wants to continue; Adventure/Logistics/Ultra sleep flags raise safety risk
conflict_types.example: Severe sleepiness vs remaining time margin

conflict_types.description: Race Strategy wants minimal stops; Logistics/Nutrition flags unverified or distant water/food
conflict_types.example: Long supply gap vs aggressive schedule

conflict_types.description: Race Strategy minimises sleep to protect margin; Ultra/Adventure recommend sleep for cognition and safety
conflict_types.example: Projected <5.3 h average sleep vs finish ambition

conflict_types.description: Equipment adequacy vs rider comfort preference
conflict_types.example: Minimal repair kit vs remote route

conflict_types.description: Ambitious stage vs user typical distance / multi-day inexperience
conflict_types.example: First bikepacking with 120 km stages when typical is 60 km

resolution_rules.explanation: Human safety always wins. System must not auto-apply a progress recommendation that overrides a critical safety flag.

resolution_rules.when: event.time_limit_hours exists AND race.time_margin_hours < threshold AND no critical safety flag
resolution_rules.action: surface_margin_warning_and_options_reduce_stops_or_replan_sleep; never force continuous riding that creates safety risk
resolution_rules.explanation: Event constraints are high priority but still subordinate to safety.

resolution_rules.when: conflicting recommendations cannot be ranked without additional user data or would require inventing values
resolution_rules.explanation: Prefer alternatives and questions over arbitrary choice.

conflict_model.notes: Coordinator (global) applies hierarchy. No voting. If two recommendations at same hierarchy level conflict, prefer the more conservative (higher safety margin) or request user choice.

no_water.name: Lack of confirmed water
no_water.limitations: Exact distance thresholds depend on carry capacity, temperature and individual needs; not hard-coded here.

flat_tire_no_repair.name: Puncture without adequate repair capability
flat_tire_no_repair.limitations: Severity depends on distance to help and terrain.

severe_sleep_deprivation.name: Severe sleep deprivation / microsleep risk
severe_sleep_deprivation.limitations: Individual variation; hallucinations and crashes documented in ultra literature. Not a diagnostic tool.

closed_resupply.name: Expected shop or water point closed or unavailable
closed_resupply.limitations: Depends on remaining reserves and distance to alternative.

drive_train_failure.name: Major drivetrain failure (chain, derailleur, hanger)
drive_train_failure.limitations: Depends on carried spares and rider skill.

extreme_weather.name: Sudden extreme weather (storm, extreme heat/cold)
extreme_weather.limitations: Medical red flags (hypothermia, heat stroke) require professional help; system is not a diagnostic tool.

gi_distress.name: Significant gastrointestinal distress during effort
gi_distress.limitations: Not diagnostic. Alarm symptoms (blood, severe pain, dehydration signs) require medical evaluation.

approaching_time_cut.name: Projected finish close to or beyond time limit
approaching_time_cut.limitations: Safety still overrides finish. System must never recommend dangerous continuous riding to beat a cut.

user_facing_template.pl: Zabierz ok. {recommended_start_l} L wody na start. Przy Twoim tempie uzupełnienie wody jest potrzebne około {resupply_needed_by_km} km (lub wcześniej na zweryfikowanym punkcie). Szacowane zapotrzebowanie etapu: {stage_need_l} L (ok. {target_l_per_h} L/h).
user_facing_template.en: Carry about {recommended_start_l} L at start. At your pace, plan water resupply by ~{resupply_needed_by_km} km (or earlier at a verified point). Stage need ~{stage_need_l} L (~{target_l_per_h} L/h).

user_facing_template.pl: Na etap potrzeba ok. {stage_cho_need_g} g węglowodanów. W zapasie masz ok. {pack_cho_g} g (żel: {gel_cho_g} g CHO). Propozycja: {suggested_pack}. Rozłóż w czasie: {feeding_schedule_hint}. Uzupełnienie ok. {resupply_needed_by_km} km, jeśli nie dokładasz zapasu.
user_facing_template.en: Stage needs ~{stage_cho_need_g} g CHO; pack ~{pack_cho_g} g (gel {gel_cho_g} g CHO). Suggested: {suggested_pack}. Spread: {feeding_schedule_hint}. Resupply by ~{resupply_needed_by_km} km if not adding food.

user_facing_template.pl: Przyjmujemy normalne odżywianie (~{target_cho_g_per_h} g CHO/h). Na start ok. {recommended_start_cho_g} g CHO pod ręką; łącznie na etap ok. {stage_cho_need_g} g. Uzupełnienie jedzenia ok. {resupply_needed_by_km} km, chyba że niesiesz pełny zapas.
user_facing_template.en: Assuming normal fueling (~{target_cho_g_per_h} g CHO/h). Start with ~{recommended_start_cho_g} g CHO; stage total ~{stage_cho_need_g} g. Food resupply by ~{resupply_needed_by_km} km unless you carry full need.

user_facing_template.pl: Na długim etapie model zakłada spadek względnej intensywności (współczynnik końcowy ok. {power_factor_end}, średni {power_factor_mean}). Zapotrzebowanie CHO/płynów jest lekko skorygowane — nie startuj „na maksa”.
user_facing_template.en: On a long stage the model assumes relative intensity decay (end factor ~{power_factor_end}, mean {power_factor_mean}). CHO/fluid targets are mildly adjusted — avoid maxing out early.

user_facing_template.pl: Planowany sen jest niski (<5,3 h/24 według heurystyki danych z konkretnego wydarzenia). To sygnał ostrzegawczy, a nie granica bezpieczeństwa. Uwzględnij wcześniejszy sen, długość wysiłku i oznaki senności. Sama wartość powyżej progu nie potwierdza bezpieczeństwa.
user_facing_template.en: Planned sleep is low (<5.3 h/24 under an event-specific heuristic). This is a warning signal, not a safety boundary. Consider prior sleep, effort duration and signs of sleepiness. A value above the trigger does not certify safety.

user_facing_template.pl: Ten plan łączy bardzo długi etap ({distance_km} km), brak planowanego snu i poziom początkujący. Nie traktuj jazdy bez snu jako celu ani sukcesu. Zmień plan: rozbij trasę na etapy z zaplanowanym snem i regeneracją albo zrezygnuj z próby. Przed startem ustal przerwanie jazdy przy senności, problemach z utrzymaniem toru, dezorientacji, silnym osłabieniu lub braku możliwości bezpiecznego uzupełnienia wody/jedzenia. Nie jedź dalej, jeśli nie jesteś w stanie bezpiecznie kontrolować roweru.
user_facing_template.en: This plan combines a very long stage ({distance_km} km), no planned sleep and beginner experience. Do not treat riding without sleep as a goal or success. Replan into stages with planned sleep and recovery, or abandon the attempt. Before starting, define stop criteria: sleepiness, difficulty holding a line, disorientation, severe weakness, or inability to safely replenish water/food. Do not continue if you cannot control the bike safely.

no_sleep_long_inexperienced.clears_when: A newly evaluated plan no longer matches the critical trigger and has an explicit safe rest/sleep plan. Clearing the rule is not a safety certification.

parameter_verification.description: Key numeric or band parameters checked against collected sources. Invented universal thresholds are forbidden.

items.value_in_kb: <1 h: not required; 1-2.5 h: 30-60 g/h; >2.5 h: up to 90 g/h MTC
items.notes: Directly from ACSM/AND/DC 2016 and Jeukendrup reviews. Absolute, not per-kg. Individual GI tolerance and intensity modifiers required.
ACSM Position Stand 2007 and Nutrition 2016. Individual sweat rate preferred over fixed ml/h.

items.value_in_kb: ~5.29 h / 24 h associated with rising sleepiness
items.notes: Single-event observational finding (n=23). Used as risk flag, not universal medical threshold. Marked moderate confidence.
Supported by event data and practical brevet guidance. Not a hard physiological law.

items.value_in_kb: referenced via src_acp_brevet_times (200 km 13h30, 600 km 40h etc.)
items.notes: Regulatory. Engine should use event-specific limit when provided rather than hard-coding.

items.parameter: Central vs peripheral fatigue with duration
items.value_in_kb: longer continuous efforts (>=3 h) increase relative central fatigue contribution
items.notes: Thomas 2015: more central fatigue after 20-40 km TTs vs 4 km. Millet: systematic voluntary activation decline in ultra, attenuated in cycling vs running. Used directionally, not as numeric cut.

items.value_in_kb: proxy ~1-1.5 min per kg on specific hilly 100 km (practical test)
items.notes: Single-tester field data. Marked limitations; aero often dominates. Not universal formula.

items.value_in_kb: no universal number; individualize to system mass, width, surface
items.notes: Field tests show surface-dependent optima. KB correctly refuses a single psi recommendation.

items.value_in_kb: operational flag only, not physiological threshold
items.notes: Marked in rule limitations as illustrative operational marker. Acceptable under KB policy when flagged as such.

items.value_in_kb: illustrative in condition; actual risk depends on carry capacity and temperature
items.notes: Rule limitations state threshold is illustrative. Engine should prefer capacity-based logic when data exist.

runtime_engine_expectations: Log every conflict resolution with hierarchy rank used
Surface insufficient_data or user_input_required rather than silent defaults
Safety critical recommendations require explicit user acknowledgement if overridden
Unknown POI capacity must produce insufficient_data, never satisfied=true.
The 0.85 coverage_safety multiplier is applied once only.
stage.estimated_time_hours is the sole canonical duration for downstream models.
effort_decay must not reduce CHO or fluid targets unless an athlete-specific validated model is introduced.

src_acsm_nutrition_2016.title: American College of Sports Medicine Joint Position Statement. Nutrition and Athletic Performance
src_acsm_nutrition_2016.key_findings: CHO guidelines by duration; individualized hydration; referral to sports RD.

src_acsm_fluid_2007.title: American College of Sports Medicine position stand. Exercise and fluid replacement
src_acsm_fluid_2007.key_findings: Prevent >2% BM loss; customize to sweat rate.

src_jeukendrup_mtc_2010.title: Carbohydrate and exercise performance: the role of multiple transportable carbohydrates
src_jeukendrup_mtc_2010.publisher: Current Opinion in Clinical Nutrition and Metabolic Care
src_jeukendrup_mtc_2010.key_findings: MTC allow higher exogenous oxidation and better performance in ≥2.5-3 h events.

src_issn_nutrient_timing_2017.title: International society of sports nutrition position stand: nutrient timing

src_race_across_france_sleep_2026.title: The Cognitive Costs of Sleep Deprivation in Ultra-Endurance Cycling: Insights From the Race Across France
src_race_across_france_sleep_2026.key_findings: Higher TST associated with better rankings; <5.29 h/day linked to increased sleepiness and cognitive decline.

src_raam_pacing_2016.title: Pacing Strategies of Ultracyclists in the Race Across AMerica
src_raam_pacing_2016.key_findings: Positive pacing common; top finishers start faster and maintain longer.

src_bikepacking_practical_mec.title: Bikepacking checklist
src_bikepacking_practical_mec.key_findings: Core repair and lighting items for self-sufficiency.

src_bikepacking_practical_ridefar.title: Sleeping Strategies & Equipment for Bikepacking Races
src_bikepacking_practical_ridefar.key_findings: Typical sleep volumes in races; caution on drowsy riding.

src_velo_gravel_pressure_2018.title: What is the optimal tire pressure for gravel?
src_velo_gravel_pressure_2018.key_findings: On gravel, lower pressures (around 30 psi for ~70 kg rider on 35 mm tire in the specific test) reduced rolling resistance compared with high pressures; too low also increased resistance. Comfort improved at lower pressures.
src_velo_gravel_pressure_2018.limitations: Small sample, specific tire and surface; not a controlled lab study across many conditions. Individual system weight critical.

src_cyclingabout_weight_2021.title: Why We Should Stop Our Obsession With Bike and Gear Weight
src_cyclingabout_weight_2021.key_findings: Extra kilogram of luggage on a hilly ~100 km course with significant elevation added roughly 1-1.5 minutes in real-world testing (model predictions ~76-80 s/kg). Aerodynamics of luggage setup often more impactful than pure mass.
src_cyclingabout_weight_2021.limitations: Single tester, specific course; not peer-reviewed scientific study.

src_thomas_fatigue_2015.title: Central and Peripheral Fatigue in Male Cyclists after 4-, 20-, and 40-km Time Trials
src_thomas_fatigue_2015.key_findings: Task-dependent fatigue: greater peripheral fatigue after short high-intensity TT (4 km); greater central fatigue (reduced voluntary activation) after longer TTs (20-40 km).
src_thomas_fatigue_2015.limitations: Trained male cyclists; laboratory TTs, not multi-day ultra.

src_millet_ultra_cns_2018.title: The role of the nervous system in neuromuscular fatigue induced by ultra-endurance exercise
src_millet_ultra_cns_2018.key_findings: Large decreases in voluntary activation common in ultra-endurance running; attenuated in ultra-endurance cycling for comparable duration/intensity. Afferent feedback likely important. Sleep deprivation elevates RPE but may not be primary driver of central fatigue per se.
src_millet_ultra_cns_2018.limitations: Most data from running; cycling-specific data more limited.

src_acp_brevet_times.title: ACP / RUSA Brevet Control Times and Speed Limits
src_acp_brevet_times.key_findings: Official minimum/maximum average speeds by distance band for ACP brevets. Intermediate controls now largely advisory; final control is timed. Example limits: 200 km 13h30, 300 km 20h, 400 km 27h, 600 km 40h, 1000 km 75h.
src_acp_brevet_times.limitations: Regulatory, not scientific performance data. Specific events may have local variations.

src_audax_sleep_practice.title: Practical sleep and midnight strategies for long Audax / brevet rides
src_audax_sleep_practice.key_findings: Sleep deprivation is a major separator of finishers vs non-finishers on 600 km+. Circadian low ~3-5 am is high-risk window. Schedule sleep or control stops into this window when possible. Chunking the ride and planned power naps are common tactics.

research_required: Detailed multi-day energy expenditure models specific to loaded bikepacking vs ultra racing
Tire pressure and rolling resistance quantifications for common gravel/MTB surfaces with luggage
Validated POI freshness models for rural/remote Europe/Poland
Gut training protocols effectiveness in recreational vs elite cyclists
Quantitative risk models for night riding with different lighting setups
Full expansion of adventure, equipment, race_strategy rule catalogs with additional primary sources
Emergency medical red-flag decision trees that stay non-diagnostic
Quantitative tire pressure models incorporating system weight + surface roughness + tire width (beyond single field tests)
Validated multi-day energy cost of loaded bikepacking vs unloaded
Multi-day energy balance and recovery nutrition models for loaded bikepacking and ultra
Intensity-modulated CHO and fluid guidance (not duration alone)
Formal multi-dimensional confidence aggregation algorithm for engine
Equipment: gearing suitability vs elevation profile; tire pressure calculators with system mass
Logistics: time-to-resupply given speed, surface and carry capacity
Unified emergency trigger_conditions normalized to standard condition interpreter

types.description: Derived from position stands or consistent research findings
Technical/logistical flag for engine; not a physiological law
Orientative practical rule with limited evidence
Derived from user profile or measured individual data
Taken from event regulations or organizer constraints

condition_format.standard: All decision rules use 'conditions' with operators: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, not_in, exists, not_exists, and, or, not. Comparison either 'value' (literal) or 'value_path' (another path).
condition_format.emergency_scenarios: Use 'trigger_conditions' as a convenience alias; engine should normalize to the same interpreter.
condition_format.recommendation: Prefer value_path when comparing two data fields; prefer value for constants. Avoid mixing path names for the same concept.

separation_of_concerns.models: Jedyna warstwa liczb: constants + formulas (DSL). PHP: eval_model_formulas. effort_decay is pacing-only; it does not reduce CHO or fluid targets.
separation_of_concerns.calculations: Kontrakt PHP 1:1 z models (engine_function, inputs, outputs). Bez drugiej kopii logiki.
separation_of_concerns.rules: Cienkie wyzwalacze IF na path (plan.*, user.*, route.*). NIE powtarzają wzorów modeli. Emitują message_key + params_from_paths.
separation_of_concerns.decision_tree: Kolejność zbierania danych i które modele odpalić. Nie liczy fizyki.
separation_of_concerns.experts: Namespace reguł (nutrition, logistics, …), nie osobne silniki liczbowe.

architecture.anti_pattern: Nie dodawaj reguły typu „30-60 g CHO/h” obok modelu, który już to zakłada. Wiedza progów = models.*.assumptions + sources.
architecture.php_workload: PHP should implement one formula evaluator + POI chain helpers. No hard-coded 0.6 L/h or 60 g/h in application code — read from models.*.constants/formulas.

name.pl: Plan wody (zapas i uzupełnienia)
name.en: Hydration carry and resupply plan

purpose.pl: Ile wody zabrać, do którego km starczy, gdzie dodać POI. Znika z listy gdy satisfied.
purpose.en: How much water to carry, coverage km, where to add POI. Clears when satisfied.

default_intake_l_per_h.source_note: Operational start point consistent with common ACSM-derived practical guidance (approx 0.4–0.8 L/h); NOT a personal sweat rate.

heat_multiplier.note: Operational multipliers only; prefer measured sweat rate.

steps: 1. Use stage.fluid_target_l_per_h_adjusted when present, otherwise stage.fluid_target_l_per_h_operational. Never recalculate from ride.estimated_time_hours here; stage_demand owns duration.
2. stage_need_l = rate * stage.estimated_time_hours * (1 + reserve_fraction). The reserve is a planning margin, not a physiological requirement.
3. Validate planned start volume against known carry capacity and max_start_l. Do not silently recommend more than the rider can carry; if capacity is unknown, mark the result incomplete.
4. coverage_hours = start_l / rate; physical coverage_km = coverage_hours * speed. Apply coverage_safety exactly once when calculating the recommended latest resupply point.
5. A POI counts only when verified/official and its availability is confirmed. A location-only POI without usable volume/capacity does not prove that the whole stage is supplied.
6. Return satisfied only when the available water volume is demonstrably sufficient. If POI quantities or chain capacity are unknown, return insufficient_data rather than true.

limitations: Default L/h is operational, not measured sweat rate. ACSM prioritizes individualization via weigh-in.
Does not model sodium needs in detail.
POI must be verification_status verified|official to count as resupply.

The current POI contract stores kilometre positions only; it does not contain refill volume or guaranteed availability. Therefore a POI chain cannot prove full-stage sufficiency. Runtime must return insufficient_data until POI capacity is modelled.

suppression.rule: Do not suggest resupply POI at km << coverage_km_from_start (e.g. avoid 10 km food POI when start buffer covers 3–4 h / long water coverage). First suggestion targets resupply_needed_by_km.

php_helpers.chain_ok: extend coverage by assuming refill to capacity at each verified POI until stage end or gap

name.pl: Plan żywienia na rowerze
name.en: On-bike nutrition pack plan

purpose.pl: Bufor CHO lub konkretna paczka; harmonogram; km uzupełnienia. Bez menu = tryb buffer.
purpose.en: CHO buffer or concrete pack; schedule; resupply km. No menu = buffer mode.

cho_g_per_h_by_duration.note: Operational mid-band targets from ACSM/Jeukendrup ranges (30-60 / up to 90). Not a prescription to force 90.

item_defaults.note: Fallbacks ONLY when user.*_cho_g is missing. Prefer user.gel_cho_g (product label). Typical commercial gels often ~20–45 g CHO.

steps: 1. Use stage.cho_target_g_per_h_adjusted when present, otherwise stage.cho_target_g_per_h_operational; stage_demand owns duration.
2. Use declared product carbohydrate values; use item defaults only when product values are unknown and mark used_default flags.
3. If user.planned_pack_declared=true, calculate the declared pack. Missing item counts are zero only after explicit declaration; otherwise mode=buffer.
4. In buffer mode, calculate only the initial buffer estimate. Do not claim the full route is fueled without confirmed food quantity/availability at resupply POIs.
5. Apply the route safety factor once to the physical coverage distance. Return insufficient_data when POI quantity or availability cannot be proven.
6. satisfied=true only when total available carbohydrate is demonstrably sufficient; otherwise return false or insufficient_data.

limitations: Item CHO defaults are typical product averages; user brands differ.
Does not replace GI feel during the ride.
Total daily energy balance is out of scope of this on-bike pack model.
A zero/empty pack must never be inferred from unanswered item-count fields; mode is controlled only by user.planned_pack_declared.

The current POI contract stores kilometre positions only; it does not contain food quantity, CHO content, opening status at arrival or guaranteed availability. A POI chain cannot prove full-stage fueling sufficiency.
The 95% coverage threshold is an operational tolerance, not a scientific adequacy threshold.

unknown_pack_policy.note: A concrete pack is used only when user.planned_pack_declared=true. Missing declaration or false selects buffer mode; zero counts are valid only after explicit declaration.

suppression.rule: Do not suggest resupply POI at km << coverage_km_from_start (e.g. avoid 10 km food POI when start buffer covers 3–4 h / long water coverage). First suggestion targets resupply_needed_by_km.

name.pl: Względne ryzyko GI vs stawka CHO
name.en: Relative GI risk vs CHO rate

purpose.en: Risk band (low/elevated/high), not a hard block.

parameters.note: These are tunable engine parameters, not universal physiological constants. They encode relative ordering consistent with literature direction (higher rate + lower experience → higher relative risk).

duration_factor.description: Slight upward adjustment for very long continuous efforts where cumulative GI load rises

message_guidance.low: Within common practice range for many riders; still monitor feel.
message_guidance.elevated: Higher than typical unpracticed rates; consider stepwise increase in training and have backup lower-rate options on the ride.
message_guidance.high: Rate associated with more frequent GI reports when gut is unaccustomed; strongly prefer practiced protocol or lower target and prioritize sensations.

engine_contract.formula_sketch: score = base_risk(rate) * experience_multiplier[gi_experience] * (duration_factor if duration > above_hours else 1.0); band = from thresholds
must_not: Treat score as probability of clinical event
Invent a personal absolute ceiling without user history
engine_contract.fallback: If target rate unknown, use duration-band default from cho_target_range and mark completeness lower

evidence.direction: Higher exogenous CHO rates increase exogenous oxidation capacity when multiple transporters are used, but GI symptom incidence remains substantial and training of the gut improves tolerance in many athletes (Jeukendrup, ACSM).
evidence.limitations: No single validated equation maps rate × experience → individual GI probability. Parameters above are heuristic relative weights for ranking, not calibrated clinical probabilities.

gi_risk_vs_cho_rate.placement: Under models (kind=probabilistic), not under experts. Experts may attach message_key to risk_band output. Does not drive stage geometry.

formulas.score: base * lookup(exp_mult, coalesce(user.gi_tolerance_high_cho, unknown), 1.0) * if(stage.estimated_time_hours > duration_boost_after_h, duration_mult, 1.0)

name.pl: Zapotrzebowanie etapu (fundament)
name.en: Stage demand foundation

purpose.pl: Wspólny węzeł: dystans, przewyższenia, nawierzchnia → czas, obciążenie, operacyjne CHO/h i L/h.
purpose.en: Shared node: distance, elevation, surface → time, load, operational CHO/h and L/h.

steps: 1. If ride.estimated_time_hours provided, use as stage.estimated_time_hours; else time = f(distance, typical_speed, surface_factor, elev_penalty, luggage_penalty)
2. climb_load_m = stage.elevation_gain_m (or sum of climb_segments.gain_m if provided)
3. If climb_segments present: steep_climb_km = sum length where avg_grade_pct >= operational steep threshold (e.g. 7%); effort factor increases with steep_km and total gain/distance
4. relative_effort_factor = 1 + k1*(gain_m/distance_km)/10 + k2*unpaved_fraction + k3*luggage_mass/body_mass (caps apply)
5. energy_kj_proxy = operational MET-like or kJ/km × distance × effort_factor (explicitly a PROXY not lab calorimetry)
6. cho_target_g_per_h_operational from duration band midpoints (0 / ~45 / ~60), optional slight uptick if effort_factor high — still operational
7. fluid_target_l_per_h_operational from default 0.6 × heat_mult × small elev factor, or user.sweat_rate if set

assumptions.energy_proxy_note: Not individual calorimetry; for planning ratios and resupply timing only

limitations: Without climb_segments, only total elevation_gain_m is used — no per-km steepness.
energy_kj_proxy must not be presented as precise personal calorie need.
GPX parsing of segments is engine responsibility; KB only defines contract.
Body mass is never imputed. When body mass or luggage mass is missing, the luggage/body ratio component is omitted and input completeness is marked partial.

formulas.relative_effort_factor: clamp(1 + gain_per_km * gain_per_km_effort_k + coalesce(route.unpaved_fraction,0) * unpaved_effort_k + coalesce(stage.luggage_effort_component,0), 1.0, effort_factor_cap)
formulas.heat_m: if(environment.temperature_c < 15, heat_mult.lt_15, if(environment.temperature_c <= 22, heat_mult.15_22, if(environment.temperature_c <= 28, heat_mult.22_28, heat_mult.gt_28)))

name.pl: Spadek intensywności / zapotrzebowania w czasie długiego wysiłku
name.en: Effort and demand decay over prolonged effort

purpose.pl: Modeluje wyłącznie spadek względnej intensywności i tempa. Nie obniża automatycznie celów żywienia ani nawodnienia.
purpose.en: Models relative intensity and pacing decay only. It does not automatically lower fueling or hydration targets.

constants.note: Directional from prolonged fatigue literature (central fatigue share rises with duration — Thomas 2015, Millet 2018). Constants are operational, not universal physiology.

demand_profile_algorithm.description: Optional piecewise profile for PHP: split stage into N segments by time or climb_segments; apply power_factor(t) per segment; sum CHO and fluid.
steps: If route.climb_segments present: for each segment compute local time proxy and local factor
Else: 4 equal time quarters with factors interpolating 1.0 → power_factor_end
stage.demand_profile = [{t0,t1, power_factor, cho_g, fluid_l}, ...]

limitations: Operational decay curve, not measured watt drop for this athlete.
CHO still required on long events even if power falls — adjustment is mild (cho_track_power=0.5).

route_planning_gate.rule: Exact stage count, stage distances, climb distribution, overnight stops and POI recommendations may be shown only when the relevant route profile, constraints and POI data are present and evaluated. Otherwise ask for missing inputs; do not generate a plausible-looking itinerary.

profile_contract.description: Grouped Ridemore profile input normalized into existing legacy user.* model paths. Profile data is a snapshot for reproducible analysis.

normalization.legacy_paths: Current models continue to consume user.* paths. PHP normalizer maps grouped input to these paths.
normalization.null_semantics: null means unknown; never convert missing/null to zero.
normalization.snapshot: Include generated_at, profile_version, source windows and activity counts with each profile snapshot.

history_aggregation.requirements: Every aggregate includes period_start, period_end, activity_count, generated_at and completeness/quality metadata.

principles: The user-requested number of days is authoritative. StagePlanner may report constraints and alternatives but must not silently change that count.
All experts consume the same canonical stage object and stable stage id/ordinal.
Moving time, stationary stops, sleep and contingency are separate quantities. Never add stops or sleep to a moving-time input.
Unknown is not zero. Every aggregate carries completeness and provenance.
POI category or geographic presence does not establish opening, quantity, capacity or resupply sufficiency.
Do not combine stage exposures into a single physiological fatigue score until a validated model and required inputs exist. Expose a transparent per-stage load ledger instead.
Stage-level expert calculations are performed per stage; trip-level accounting aggregates stage outputs without recomputing them.
No universal fluid intake, sweat rate, sodium dose, sleep minimum or fatigue threshold is inferred from missing personal data.
Inventory events are applied in route order; a later resupply never retroactively closes an earlier shortage.

canonical_stage.time_semantics: stage.estimated_time_hours is retained as a compatibility alias for moving time only. It must never contain stops or sleep.

aggregation.moving_time: sum(known stage moving times); unknown if any required stage moving time is absent, with known subtotal retained separately
aggregation.stops: sum declared stop times; unknown/partial when one or more stage stop values are absent
aggregation.sleep: sum planned sleep values; unknown/partial when any relevant overnight interval is not declared
aggregation.elapsed: moving + stops + sleep + explicitly supplied contingency; never substitute missing components with zero without marking partial
aggregation.load_ledger: one row per stage with stage id, ordinal, moving hours, distance, ascent, surface exposure, energy proxy, rest interval before next stage, source and confidence

eligibility_rules: Only official/verified POIs with sufficiently fresh data may be considered confirmed supply candidates.
open_status_at_arrival=open_confirmed is required for time-dependent resupply confirmation; unknown hours means unknown availability.
Water resupply requires known accessible water volume or an explicitly defined refill capacity; presence alone is insufficient.
Food resupply requires known CHO quantity for nutrition accounting; food category alone is insufficient.
Capacity status must be confirmed for the amount required by the plan; unknown capacity cannot close a supply gap.
Detour distance is included in route distance and time only when supplied by route/POI analysis; never silently omit a material detour.
Retain excluded POIs and the reason for exclusion; do not delete uncertain candidates from the audit trail.
poi_access.adapter_boundary: Ridemore owns POI category taxonomy, master IDs, sources and verification workflow. This engine contract consumes normalized fields and does not define a second POI category dictionary.

stage_load_and_recovery.method: Expose per-stage components and inter-stage recovery intervals. Do not calculate a single cumulative fatigue score or infer recovery adequacy from sleep hours alone until a separately sourced and validated model is implemented.
limitations: Energy proxy is not a direct physiological measurement.
Sleep duration alone does not establish sleep quality or recovery.
No fatigue-decay factor may reduce CHO or fluid targets.

discipline_and_event_context.rule: Discipline selects relevant route/surface/equipment/event constraints; it must not create unsupported physiological multipliers. Training preparation is a distinct analysis type requiring an event date, event demands and available training history.

implementation_order: Normalize profile and route inputs with provenance.
Run stage_demand once per stage and pass its moving-time result downstream.
Run nutrition and hydration per stage with that stage's inventory and confirmed resupply events.
Run POI access assessment against estimated arrival times and quantities.
Build trip time and stage-load ledgers without recalculating stage demand.
Compose recommendations with traceable source rules, confidence and missing-data reasons.

processing: Stages are processed by ascending ordinal; closing physical stock becomes the next stage opening stock.
Events are processed by route_km. Demand is allocated linearly by distance between events; this approximation is recorded in each ledger row.
Consumption up to an event position is deducted before the event is applied. Later resupply never retroactively closes an earlier shortage.
Only events meeting every confirmation requirement change stock. Unconfirmed events remain visible with an exclusion reason.
Missing starting stock or stage demand remains unknown, never zero. Unknown demand makes closing stock unknown.
Shortage is recorded at the point it occurs. Later resupply does not erase earlier shortage.
Negative stock is not carried forward; carry forward non-negative physical remainder and preserve shortage separately.
If stage distance is missing or non-positive, event positions cannot be validated and no within-stage resupply is credited.
limitations: Linear demand by distance is an accounting approximation, not a physiological intake curve; it does not model terrain-dependent consumption or exact timestamps.
The ledger accounts declared demand and confirmed quantities; it does not prescribe intake rates.
This is reference Python behavior, not production PHP.
